rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that covers all or most aspects.

example.english: This report provides a comprehensive analysis of the problem.
example.traditional: 呢份報告全面分析咗個問題。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 cyun4 min6 fan1 sik1 zo2 go3 man6 tai4

rows.note: Use this when a collection, range, or set contains all the necessary items rather than when discussing aspects of a subject.

example.english: This shop has a comprehensive range of camping gear.
example.traditional: 呢間舖頭嘅露營用品好齊全。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau4 ge3 lou6 jing4 jung6 ban2 hou2 cai4 cyun4

rows.note: Use this for a report, explanation, or treatment that is comprehensive because it gives extensive detail.

example.english: Your explanation is comprehensive, so I understood it at a glance.
example.traditional: 你份解釋夠詳盡，我一睇就明。
example.jyutping: nei5 fan6 gaai2 sik1 gau3 coeng4 zeon6 ngo5 jat1 tai2 zau6 ming4

rows.note: Use this emphatic expression for something that includes an extremely wide range of things, especially in more formal or literary wording.

example.english: This encyclopedia is comprehensive, with information on everything.
example.traditional: 呢本百科全書包羅萬有，乜資料都有。
example.jyutping: ni1 bun2 baak3 fo1 cyun4 syu1 baau1 lo4 maan6 jau5 mat1 zi1 liu6 dou1 jau5
